rule: STAGE1_PLAN.md section 3 step 8: the panels' measures run on the nominal reference itself reproduce Stage 0's.  The reference is played kinematically on the plant's model (its frames interpolated in time at the 2 ms physics step, the root carried one stride per period; no physics) into a metrics.Recorder: the CoM, feet, soles and lowest points from the frames' kinematics at 100 Hz, each foot's load the weight shared over the reference's support flags at every physics step; over 10 s from the second stride, metrics.window's cadence and LOOK_RULE's sway against Stage 0's: the reference's own (refs.json: cadence_steps_s, 2 / period; sway = 2 x gait.generate's sway_amp / H, the peak-to-peak lateral CoM of the stride, as round two reported it) within half a unit of the plan's last digit (0.0005 H, 0.005 steps/s), and equal to the plan's figures when rounded to their digits (sway 0.168 / 0.169 / 0.164 H, cadence 1.96 / 1.97 / 1.76 steps/s); duty, stride, toe clearance and the head and tail amplitudes are reported beside them

stage0.source: refs.json references.nominal: info.sway_amp (gait.generate: half the CoM path's lateral peak to peak) and cadence_steps_s, the records round two's reports read (decision 9)
